property_summary: After a call to play() by a non-bank caller, the reference contract's balance becomes 0 (if random wins) or msg.value (if random loses), while the buggy contract's balance is always reduced by an extra 1 wei fee, causing a divergence when random == 1 (i.e., no win) because the reference keeps 10 wei and the buggy keeps 9 wei.
change_summary: Add a second transfer to bank before the random check, making bank always receive an additional fee.
